fields.acceptance: A web package test drives the events handler with a recorder, appends a log entry, a run journal move, driver log lines and an inbox item and changes the daemon's status in a fixture repo, and reads one matching named event for each from the stream.
fields.statement: GET /events streams server-sent events naming what changed (a change set moved or landed, a run's journal moved, a run's driver log grew, an inbox item arrived or left, the daemon's status changed: paused, slots or health), so an open page knows to re-fetch.
